demo_chips: Do you install home EV charging stations?
Can I get a free estimate?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach A&E Electrical Solutions at (520) 274-5641 or AEElectricalSolutionsLLC@gmail.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.a: Yes - A&E Electrical Solutions is fully licensed, bonded, and insured under Arizona ROC #353902.
Yes - estimates are free across the Tucson metro area. Call (520) 274-5641 or leave your name and email here and the team will follow up with honest pricing and a clear plan.
Yes - emergency service is available 24/7. Power issues don't wait for business hours, and neither do we. Call (520) 274-5641 any time, day or night.

We modernize your service panel for today's demand - safer breakers, higher amperage, and full code compliance. Work is permitted, inspected, and signed off. A modern panel also helps with high-demand appliances like EVs, AC, and hot tubs, and can add value at resale.
faqs.q: What does a panel upgrade involve?

faqs.a: Yes - we install Level 2 home and commercial EV charging stations, clean and to manufacturer spec, including Tesla Wall Connectors.
We serve Tucson, Marana, Oro Valley, Vail, and Sahuarita, and neighbors across southern Arizona.
The A&E Electrical Solutions crew brings 20+ years of combined hands-on residential and commercial experience to every job, and the business is owner-operated - you deal directly with the owner.
